title: VibePod Data Explorer
description: Datasette UI for VibePod session logs and HTTP proxy traffic.

agent-tokens.title: All Agents Token Usage
agent-tokens.description: Total token consumption across every VibePod agent. Values are parsed once per captured response into the usage cache database, so the dashboard reads plain integers instead of re-scanning response bodies.

agent.name: Agent
agent.query: SELECT agent FROM (SELECT 'all' AS agent, 0 AS ord UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT agent, 1 AS ord FROM token_usage) ORDER BY ord, agent

cost_trend.title: Cost over time (confirmed vs estimated)
cost_trend.query: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_cost WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)), priced AS (SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE has_usage = 1) SELECT bucket, series, ROUND(SUM(cost), 4) AS cost FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = '5min' OR (COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'auto' AND COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') IN ('1h', '2h', '4h')) THEN datetime((strftime('%s', datetime(timestamp)) / 300) * 300, 'unixepoch') WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'hour' OR (COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'auto' AND COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = '24h') THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', datetime(timestamp)) WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'week' THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(timestamp, 'weekday 0', '-6 days')) WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'month' THEN strftime('%Y-%m-01', datetime(timestamp)) ELSE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(timestamp)) END AS bucket, 'confirmed' AS series, SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 0 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS cost FROM priced GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = '5min' OR (COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'auto' AND COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') IN ('1h', '2h', '4h')) THEN datetime((strftime('%s', datetime(timestamp)) / 300) * 300, 'unixepoch') WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'hour' OR (COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'auto' AND COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = '24h') THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', datetime(timestamp)) WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'week' THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(timestamp, 'weekday 0', '-6 days')) WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'month' THEN strftime('%Y-%m-01', datetime(timestamp)) ELSE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(timestamp)) END AS bucket, 'estimated' AS series, SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 1 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS cost FROM priced GROUP BY bucket) GROUP BY bucket, series ORDER BY bucket, series

cost_change.title: Confirmed cost change vs previous period (%)
cost_change.query: WITH scoped AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_cost WHERE has_usage = 1 AND has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 0 AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)), windows AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END) THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS current_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END, CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END) AND datetime(timestamp) < datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END) THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS previous_cost FROM scoped) SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' THEN NULL WHEN previous_cost = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (current_cost - previous_cost) / previous_cost, 1) END AS cost_change_pct FROM windows

1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent) ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(:request_sort, 'timestamp_desc') = 'timestamp_asc' THEN datetime(r.timestamp) END ASC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(:request_sort, 'timestamp_desc') = 'timestamp_desc' THEN datetime(r.timestamp) END DESC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(:request_sort, 'timestamp_desc') = 'duration_asc' THEN resp.duration_ms END ASC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(:request_sort, 'timestamp_desc') = 'duration_desc' THEN resp.duration_ms END DESC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(:request_sort, 'timestamp_desc') = 'status_asc' THEN resp.status_code END ASC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(:request_sort, 'timestamp_desc') = 'status_desc' THEN resp.status_code END DESC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(:request_sort, 'timestamp_desc') = 'errors_first' THEN CASE WHEN resp.status_code >= 400 OR err.error_type IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END END ASC, datetime(r.timestamp) DESC LIMIT CAST(CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(:request_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) < 20 THEN 20 WHEN CAST(COALESCE(:request_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) > 500 THEN 500 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(:request_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) END AS INTEGER)

filter_mode_now.title: Filter mode (last seen)
filter_mode_now.query: SELECT COALESCE(filter_mode, 'unknown') AS filter_mode FROM http_requests WHERE filter_mode IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

blocked_requests.title: Blocked requests
blocked_requests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS blocked_requests FROM http_requests r WHERE r.blocked = 1 AND (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (TRIM(COALESCE(:host_query, '')) = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.host, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(TRIM(:host_query)) || '%') AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent)

decisions_by_profile.title: Filter decisions by profile (filter active)
decisions_by_profile.query: SELECT profile, series, hits FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.profile, ''), 'unknown') AS profile, 'blocked' AS series, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM http_requests r WHERE r.blocked = 1 AND (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (TRIM(COALESCE(:host_query, '')) = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.host, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(TRIM(:host_query)) || '%') AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent) GROUP BY profile UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.profile, ''), 'unknown'), 'passed', COUNT(*) FROM http_requests r WHERE r.blocked = 0 AND r.filter_mode IN ('allow', 'deny') AND (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (TRIM(COALESCE(:host_query, '')) = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.host, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(TRIM(:host_query)) || '%') AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent) GROUP BY profile) ORDER BY profile, series

blocked_hosts_table.title: Blocked hosts (allow-miss = candidates for the allow list)
blocked_hosts_table.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.host, ''), 'unknown') AS host, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.profile, ''), 'unknown') AS profile, COALESCE(r.filter_mode, 'unknown') AS filter_mode, COALESCE(r.block_reason, 'unknown') AS block_reason, COUNT(*) AS hits, MAX(r.timestamp) AS last_seen FROM http_requests r WHERE r.blocked = 1 AND (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (TRIM(COALESCE(:host_query, '')) = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.host, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(TRIM(:host_query)) || '%') AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent) GROUP BY host, profile, filter_mode, block_reason ORDER BY hits DESC, host ASC LIMIT 25

passed_hosts_table.title: Passed with filter active (deny mode = candidates for the deny list)
passed_hosts_table.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.host, ''), 'unknown') AS host, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.profile, ''), 'unknown') AS profile, r.filter_mode, COUNT(*) AS hits, MAX(r.timestamp) AS last_seen FROM http_requests r WHERE r.blocked = 0 AND r.filter_mode IN ('allow', 'deny') AND (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (TRIM(COALESCE(:host_query, '')) = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.host, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(TRIM(:host_query)) || '%') AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent) GROUP BY host, profile, r.filter_mode ORDER BY hits DESC, host ASC LIMIT 25

agent-sessions.title: Agent Sessions Dashboard
agent-sessions.description: Session and message usage by agent over time, from VibePod session logs.

agent.name: Agent
agent.query: SELECT agent FROM (SELECT 'all' AS agent, 0 AS ord UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT agent, 1 AS ord FROM sessions WHERE agent IS NOT NULL AND agent != '') ORDER BY ord, agent

workspace.name: Workspace
workspace.query: SELECT workspace FROM (SELECT 'all' AS workspace, 0 AS ord UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT workspace, 1 AS ord FROM sessions WHERE workspace IS NOT NULL AND workspace != '') ORDER BY ord, workspace

total_sessions.title: Total sessions
total_sessions.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions FROM sessions s WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace)

total_messages.title: Total messages
total_messages.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_messages FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace)

avg_sessions_per_day.title: Avg sessions / day
avg_sessions_per_day.query: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT substr(s.started_at, 1, 10)), 0), 2) AS avg_sessions_per_day FROM sessions s WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace)

avg_messages_per_session.title: Avg messages / session
avg_messages_per_session.query: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(m.id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 0), 2) AS avg_messages_per_session FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace)

avg_session_duration_min.title: Avg session duration
avg_session_duration_min.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG((unixepoch(ended_at) - unixepoch(started_at)) / 60.0), 1) AS avg_session_duration_min FROM sessions s WHERE s.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace)

agent_share.title: Sessions by agent
agent_share.query: SELECT s.agent AS agent, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM sessions s WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace) GROUP BY s.agent ORDER BY session_count DESC, s.agent ASC LIMIT 20

top_workspaces.title: Top workspaces
top_workspaces.query: WITH ws_sessions AS ( SELECT s.workspace AS workspace, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM sessions s WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace) GROUP BY s.workspace ), ws_messages AS ( SELECT s.workspace AS workspace, COUNT(m.id) AS message_count FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace) GROUP BY s.workspace ) SELECT wss.workspace, wss.session_count, COALESCE(wm.message_count, 0) AS message_count FROM ws_sessions wss LEFT JOIN ws_messages wm ON wm.workspace = wss.workspace ORDER BY wss.session_count DESC, wss.workspace ASC LIMIT 15

sessions_by_day.title: Sessions over time
sessions_by_day.query: WITH filtered AS ( SELECT s.started_at AS ts, s.agent AS agent FROM sessions s WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace) ) SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'hour' OR (COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'auto' AND COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') IN ('1h', '2h', '4h', '24h')) THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', datetime(ts)) ELSE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(ts)) END AS bucket, agent AS series, COUNT(*) AS value FROM filtered GROUP BY bucket, agent ORDER BY bucket, agent

time_of_day.title: Sessions by hour of day
time_of_day.query: WITH filtered AS ( SELECT s.started_at AS ts FROM sessions s WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace) ) SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', datetime(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM filtered GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day ASC

recent_sessions.title: Recent sessions
recent_sessions.query: WITH filtered AS ( SELECT s.id, s.agent, s.workspace, s.profile, s.container_name, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.exit_reason FROM sessions s WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(s.started_at) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR s.agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR s.workspace = :workspace) ), msg_counts AS ( SELECT m.session_id, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM messages m JOIN filtered f ON f.id = m.session_id GROUP BY m.session_id ) SELECT f.id AS session_id, f.agent, f.workspace, f.profile, f.container_name, f.started_at, f.ended_at, f.exit_reason, COALESCE(mc.message_count, 0) AS message_count FROM filtered f LEFT JOIN msg_counts mc ON mc.session_id = f.id ORDER BY datetime(f.started_at) DESC LIMIT CAST(CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(:session_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) < 20 THEN 20 WHEN CAST(COALESCE(:session_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) > 500 THEN 500 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(:session_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) END AS INTEGER)

agent-proxy-requests.title: Agent Proxy Requests Dashboard
agent-proxy-requests.description: Proxy HTTP request volume by agent over time, derived from http_requests.source_container_name.

agent.name: Agent
agent.query: SELECT agent FROM (SELECT 'all' AS agent, 0 AS ord UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(source_container_name, 9) END ELSE source_container_name END AS agent, 1 AS ord FROM http_requests WHERE source_container_name IS NOT NULL AND source_container_name != '') ORDER BY ord, agent

total_proxy_requests.title: Total proxy requests
total_proxy_requests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_proxy_requests FROM http_requests r WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent)

requests_by_agent.title: Requests by agent
requests_by_agent.query: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END AS agent, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM http_requests r WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent) GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END ORDER BY request_count DESC, agent ASC LIMIT 20

requests_over_time.title: Requests over time
requests_over_time.query: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'hour' OR (COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'auto' AND COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') IN ('1h', '2h', '4h', '24h')) THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', datetime(r.timestamp)) ELSE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(r.timestamp)) END AS bucket, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END AS series, COUNT(*) AS value FROM http_requests r WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent) GROUP BY bucket, series ORDER BY bucket, series

recent_proxy_requests.title: Recent proxy requests
recent_proxy_requests.query: SELECT r.id AS request_id, r.timestamp, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END AS agent, COALESCE(r.method, '?') AS method, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.host, ''), 'unknown') AS host, r.path FROM http_requests r WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '7d') WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' ELSE '-7 days' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_container_name, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN r.source_container_name LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), 1, instr(substr(r.source_container_name, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(r.source_container_name, 9) END ELSE r.source_container_name END = :agent) ORDER BY datetime(r.timestamp) DESC LIMIT CAST(CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(:request_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) < 20 THEN 20 WHEN CAST(COALESCE(:request_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) > 500 THEN 500 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(:request_limit, 100) AS INTEGER) END AS INTEGER)

logs.title: Session Logs
logs.description: Interactive sessions and submitted messages captured by VibePod.

recent_sessions.title: Recent sessions
recent_sessions.sql: SELECT s.id, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.agent, s.container_name, s.exit_reason, COUNT(m.id) AS message_count FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.session_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.started_at DESC LIMIT CAST(COALESCE(:limit, 100) AS INTEGER)

recent_messages.title: Recent messages
recent_messages.sql: SELECT m.timestamp, m.session_id, s.agent, s.container_name, m.content FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id ORDER BY m.timestamp DESC LIMIT CAST(COALESCE(:limit, 200) AS INTEGER)

codex_ws_recent_messages.title: Codex websocket recent messages
codex_ws_recent_messages.sql: SELECT ws.timestamp, ws.request_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.source_container_name, ''), 'unknown') AS source_container, COALESCE(NULLIF(extract_model(r.body), ''), 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(NULLIF(ws.direction, ''), 'unknown') AS direction, COALESCE(NULLIF(CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.type') END, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(ws.type, ''), 'unknown')) AS message_type, CASE WHEN LENGTH(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) > CAST(COALESCE(:preview_len, 220) AS INTEGER) THEN SUBSTR(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), 1, CAST(COALESCE(:preview_len, 220) AS INTEGER)) || '...' COALESCE(NULLIF(ws.type, ''), 'unknown')) AS message_type, CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.input_tokens'), json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.prompt_tokens')) AS INTEGER) END AS input_tokens, CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.output_tokens'), json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.completion_tokens')) AS INTEGER) END AS output_tokens, CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens'), json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens')) AS INTEGER) END AS cached_tokens, CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens'), json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens')) AS INTEGER) END AS reasoning_tokens FROM websocket_messages ws JOIN http_requests r ON r.id = ws.request_id WHERE r.host = 'chatgpt.com' AND r.path LIKE '/backend-api/codex/%' AND (COALESCE(:hours, 0) = 0 OR datetime(ws.timestamp) >= datetime('now', '-' || CAST(COALESCE(:hours, 0) AS TEXT) || ' hours'))) SELECT message_type, COUNT(*) AS message_count, SUM(CASE WHEN input_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_input_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN output_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_output_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN cached_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_cached_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN reasoning_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_reasoning_tokens, SUM(COALESCE(input_tokens, 0)) AS sum_input_tokens, SUM(COALESCE(output_tokens, 0)) AS sum_output_tokens FROM parsed GROUP BY message_type ORDER BY message_count DESC LIMIT CAST(COALESCE(:limit, 200) AS INTEGER)

codex_ws_usage_event_duplicates.title: Codex websocket duplicate usage events

codex_ws_tokens_vs_http_by_request.title: Codex websocket vs HTTP tokens by request
codex_ws_tokens_vs_http_by_request.sql: WITH ws_usage AS (SELECT ws.request_id, MAX(ws.timestamp) AS latest_ws_timestamp, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.source_container_name, ''), 'unknown') AS source_container, COALESCE(NULLIF(extract_model(r.body), ''), 'unknown') AS model, COUNT(*) AS ws_message_count, SUM(COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.input_tokens'), json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.prompt_tokens')) AS INTEGER) END, 0)) AS ws_input_tokens, SUM(COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.output_tokens'), json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.completion_tokens')) AS INTEGER) END, 0)) AS ws_output_tokens, SUM(COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens'), json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens')) AS INTEGER) END, 0)) AS ws_cached_tokens, SUM(COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens'), json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.response.usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens')) AS INTEGER) END, 0)) AS ws_reasoning_tokens FROM websocket_messages ws JOIN http_requests r ON r.id = ws.request_id WHERE r.host = 'chatgpt.com' AND r.path LIKE '/backend-api/codex/%' AND (COALESCE(:hours, 0) = 0 OR datetime(ws.timestamp) >= datetime('now', '-' || CAST(COALESCE(:hours, 0) AS TEXT) || ' hours')) GROUP BY ws.request_id, source_container, model), http_usage AS (SELECT r.id AS request_id, COALESCE(CASE WHEN resp.body IS NOT NULL AND json_valid(decode_body(resp.body)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(decode_body(resp.body), '$.usage.input_tokens'), json_extract(decode_body(resp.body), '$.usage.prompt_tokens')) AS INTEGER) WHEN resp.body IS NOT NULL AND instr(decode_body(resp.body), '"input_tokens":') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(decode_body(resp.body), instr(decode_body(resp.body), '"input_tokens":') + 15, 10) AS INTEGER) WHEN resp.body IS NOT NULL AND instr(decode_body(resp.body), '"prompt_tokens":') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(decode_body(resp.body), instr(decode_body(resp.body), '"prompt_tokens":') + 16, 10) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END, 0) AS http_input_tokens, COALESCE(CASE WHEN resp.body IS NOT NULL AND json_valid(decode_body(resp.body)) THEN CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(decode_body(resp.body), '$.usage.output_tokens'), json_extract(decode_body(resp.body), '$.usage.completion_tokens')) AS INTEGER) WHEN resp.body IS NOT NULL AND instr(decode_body(resp.body), '"output_tokens":') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(decode_body(resp.body), instr(decode_body(resp.body), '"output_tokens":') + 16, 10) AS INTEGER) WHEN resp.body IS NOT NULL AND instr(decode_body(resp.body), '"completion_tokens":') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(decode_body(resp.body), instr(decode_body(resp.body), '"completion_tokens":') + 20, 10) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END, 0) AS http_output_tokens FROM http_requests r LEFT JOIN http_responses resp ON resp.request_id = r.id WHERE r.host = 'chatgpt.com' AND r.path LIKE '/backend-api/codex/%') SELECT ws.request_id, ws.latest_ws_timestamp AS timestamp, ws.source_container, ws.model, ws.ws_message_count, ws.ws_input_tokens, ws.ws_output_tokens, ws.ws_cached_tokens, ws.ws_reasoning_tokens, (ws.ws_input_tokens + ws.ws_output_tokens) AS ws_total_tokens, COALESCE(http.http_input_tokens, 0) AS http_input_tokens, COALESCE(http.http_output_tokens, 0) AS http_output_tokens, (COALESCE(http.http_input_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(http.http_output_tokens, 0)) AS http_total_tokens, (ws.ws_input_tokens + ws.ws_output_tokens) - (COALESCE(http.http_input_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(http.http_output_tokens, 0)) AS total_token_delta FROM ws_usage ws LEFT JOIN http_usage http ON http.request_id = ws.request_id WHERE (COALESCE(:request_id, '') = '' OR CAST(ws.request_id AS TEXT) = CAST(:request_id AS TEXT)) ORDER BY datetime(ws.latest_ws_timestamp) DESC LIMIT CAST(COALESCE(:limit, 200) AS INTEGER)

agent_token_usage_live.title: Agent token usage (normalized across providers) (live scan)
agent_token_usage_live.sql: WITH http_raw AS (SELECT r.id AS request_id, r.timestamp AS ts, r.host AS host, r.source_container_name AS container, extract_model(r.body) AS model, extract_usage(resp.body, r.host) AS usage_json FROM http_requests r JOIN http_responses resp ON resp.request_id = r.id WHERE r.method = 'POST' AND resp.body IS NOT NULL AND length(resp.body) > 0 AND (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(r.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM websocket_messages ws2 WHERE ws2.request_id = r.id AND json_valid(CAST(ws2.content AS TEXT)) AND json_extract(CAST(ws2.content AS TEXT), '$.type') = 'response.completed')), ws_raw AS (SELECT ws.request_id AS request_id, ws.timestamp AS ts, r.host AS host, r.source_container_name AS container, extract_model(r.body) AS model, extract_usage(ws.content, r.host) AS usage_json FROM websocket_messages ws JOIN http_requests r ON r.id = ws.request_id WHERE json_valid(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT)) AND json_extract(CAST(ws.content AS TEXT), '$.type') = 'response.completed' AND (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(ws.timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END))), combined AS (SELECT * FROM http_raw UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws_raw), usage_rows AS (SELECT request_id, ts, COALESCE(NULLIF(host, ''), 'unknown') AS host, CASE WHEN COALESCE(container, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN container LIKE 'vibepod-%' THEN CASE WHEN instr(substr(container, 9), '-') > 0 THEN substr(substr(container, 9), 1, instr(substr(container, 9), '-') - 1) ELSE substr(container, 9) END ELSE container END AS agent, COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(usage_json, '$.provider'), ''), 'unknown') AS provider, CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(usage_json, '$.input'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS input_tokens, CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(usage_json, '$.output'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS output_tokens, CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(usage_json, '$.cached'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS cached_tokens, CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(usage_json, '$.cache_write'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS cache_write_tokens, CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(usage_json, '$.reasoning'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS reasoning_tokens, CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(usage_json, '$.found'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS has_usage FROM combined), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM usage_rows WHERE (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host)), priced AS (SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE has_usage = 1) SELECT ts AS timestamp, agent, provider, model, host, request_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_tokens, input_tokens + output_tokens AS total_tokens FROM priced ORDER BY datetime(ts) DESC LIMIT CAST(COALESCE(:limit, 200) AS INTEGER)

agent_token_totals.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_usage WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)), priced AS (SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE has_usage = 1) SELECT agent, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens, SUM(cache_write_tokens) AS cache_write_tokens, SUM(reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS total_tokens FROM priced GROUP BY agent ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

cost_over_time.name: Cost per period
cost_over_time.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_cost WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)), priced AS (SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE has_usage = 1) SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = '5min' OR (COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'auto' AND COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') IN ('1h', '2h', '4h')) THEN datetime((strftime('%s', datetime(timestamp)) / 300) * 300, 'unixepoch') WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'hour' OR (COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'auto' AND COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = '24h') THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', datetime(timestamp)) WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'week' THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(timestamp, 'weekday 0', '-6 days')) WHEN COALESCE(:time_bucket, 'auto') = 'month' THEN strftime('%Y-%m-01', datetime(timestamp)) ELSE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(timestamp)) END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS calls, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 0 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) AS confirmed_cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 1 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) AS estimated_cost_usd, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS total_tokens FROM priced GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket DESC

agent_token_coverage.title: Token usage coverage by host
agent_token_coverage.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_usage WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)) SELECT host, provider, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(has_usage) AS parsed_calls, SUM(1 - has_usage) AS unparsed_calls FROM filtered GROUP BY host, provider ORDER BY unparsed_calls DESC, calls DESC

usage_cache_state.title: Usage cache freshness
usage_cache_state.sql: SELECT s.source, s.last_row_id, s.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_usage t WHERE t.source = s.source) AS cached_rows, (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM token_usage t WHERE t.source = s.source) AS latest_row FROM sync_state s ORDER BY s.source

usage_duplicate_events.title: Duplicate usage events (suppressed from totals)
usage_duplicate_events.sql: SELECT request_id, response_id, source, COUNT(*) AS events, MIN(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS min_tokens, MAX(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS max_tokens, MIN(timestamp) AS first_seen, MAX(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM token_usage WHERE response_id != '' GROUP BY request_id, response_id, source HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY events DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT CAST(COALESCE(:limit, 100) AS INTEGER)

agent_token_calls_per_connection.title: Model calls per captured connection
agent_token_calls_per_connection.sql: SELECT request_id, host, agent, COUNT(*) AS model_calls, COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS distinct_responses, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS total_tokens FROM agent_token_usage WHERE has_usage = 1 GROUP BY request_id, host, agent ORDER BY model_calls DESC, total_tokens DESC LIMIT CAST(COALESCE(:limit, 100) AS INTEGER)

workspace_token_totals.name: Tokens per workspace
workspace_token_totals.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_usage WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)), priced AS (SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE has_usage = 1) SELECT workspace, workspace_name, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens, SUM(cache_write_tokens) AS cache_write_tokens, SUM(reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS total_tokens FROM priced GROUP BY workspace_name, workspace ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

profile_token_totals.name: Tokens per profile
profile_token_totals.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_usage WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)), priced AS (SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE has_usage = 1) SELECT profile, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens, SUM(cache_write_tokens) AS cache_write_tokens, SUM(reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS total_tokens FROM priced GROUP BY profile ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

session_token_totals.name: Tokens per session
session_token_totals.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_cost WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)), priced AS (SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE has_usage = 1) SELECT session_id, MAX(agent) AS agent, MAX(workspace_name) AS workspace, MAX(profile) AS profile, COUNT(*) AS calls, MIN(timestamp) AS first_call, MAX(timestamp) AS last_call, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens, SUM(cache_write_tokens) AS cache_write_tokens, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS total_tokens, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 0 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) AS confirmed_cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 1 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) AS estimated_cost_usd FROM priced GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

workspace_resolution.name: Workspace resolution diagnostics
workspace_resolution.sql: SELECT container_id, container_name, workspace, workspace_name, COUNT(*) AS resolved_rows FROM token_usage WHERE workspace != '' GROUP BY container_id, container_name, workspace, workspace_name UNION ALL SELECT container_id, container_name, 'unknown-pending', '', COUNT(*) FROM token_usage WHERE workspace = '' GROUP BY container_id, container_name ORDER BY resolved_rows DESC

profile_resolution.name: Profile resolution diagnostics
profile_resolution.sql: SELECT container_id, container_name, profile, COUNT(*) AS resolved_rows FROM token_usage WHERE profile != '' GROUP BY container_id, container_name, profile UNION ALL SELECT container_id, container_name, 'unknown-pending', COUNT(*) FROM token_usage WHERE profile = '' GROUP BY container_id, container_name ORDER BY resolved_rows DESC

session_resolution.name: Session resolution diagnostics
session_resolution.sql: SELECT container_id, container_name, session_id, COUNT(*) AS resolved_rows FROM token_usage WHERE session_id != '' GROUP BY container_id, container_name, session_id UNION ALL SELECT container_id, container_name, 'unknown-pending', COUNT(*) FROM token_usage WHERE session_id = '' GROUP BY container_id, container_name ORDER BY resolved_rows DESC

pricing_coverage.name: Pricing coverage by provider and model
pricing_coverage.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_cost WHERE has_usage = 1) SELECT provider, model, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(has_price) AS priced_calls, SUM(1 - has_price) AS unpriced_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 0 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS real_cost_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 1 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS estimated_cost_usd FROM filtered GROUP BY provider, model ORDER BY unpriced_calls DESC, calls DESC LIMIT CAST(COALESCE(:limit, 100) AS INTEGER)

cost_per_request.name: Cost per request by provider and model
cost_per_request.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM agent_token_cost WHERE (COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') = 'all' OR datetime(timestamp) >= datetime('now', CASE COALESCE(:time_range, '24h') WHEN '1h' THEN '-1 hours' WHEN '2h' THEN '-2 hours' WHEN '4h' THEN '-4 hours' WHEN '24h' THEN '-24 hours' WHEN '7d' THEN '-7 days' WHEN '30d' THEN '-30 days' WHEN '3m' THEN '-90 days' WHEN '6m' THEN '-180 days' WHEN '1y' THEN '-365 days' ELSE '-24 hours' END)) AND (COALESCE(:agent, 'all') = 'all' OR agent = :agent) AND (COALESCE(:provider, 'all') = 'all' OR provider = :provider) AND (COALESCE(:host, 'all') = 'all' OR host = :host) AND (COALESCE(:workspace, 'all') = 'all' OR workspace = :workspace) AND (COALESCE(:profile, 'all') = 'all' OR profile = :profile) AND (COALESCE(:model, 'all') = 'all' OR model = :model)), priced AS (SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE has_usage = 1) , confirmed AS (SELECT * FROM priced WHERE has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 0), ranked AS (SELECT provider, model, cost_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY provider, model ORDER BY cost_usd) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY provider, model) AS n FROM confirmed), stats AS (SELECT provider, model, n AS confirmed_calls, ROUND(AVG(cost_usd), 6) AS avg_cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2) THEN cost_usd END), 6) AS median_cost_usd, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MIN(n, (n * 95 + 99) / 100) THEN cost_usd END), 6) AS p95_cost_usd, ROUND(MAX(cost_usd), 6) AS max_cost_usd FROM ranked GROUP BY provider, model, n), totals AS (SELECT provider, model, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN has_price = 1 AND is_estimated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS estimated_calls, SUM(1 - has_price) AS unpriced_calls FROM priced GROUP BY provider, model) SELECT t.provider, t.model, t.calls, COALESCE(s.confirmed_calls, 0) AS confirmed_calls, t.estimated_calls, t.unpriced_calls, s.avg_cost_usd, s.median_cost_usd, s.p95_cost_usd, s.max_cost_usd FROM totals t LEFT JOIN stats s ON s.provider = t.provider AND s.model = t.model ORDER BY COALESCE(s.avg_cost_usd, 0) DESC, t.calls DESC

model_pricing_table.name: Current model pricing table
model_pricing_table.sql: SELECT provider, model, effective_from, input_price_per_1m, output_price_per_1m, cached_price_per_1m, cache_write_price_per_1m, currency, is_estimated, price_source FROM model_pricing ORDER BY provider, model, effective_from
